security_audit.summary: The hardcoded URL is a real dependency because the live catalog determines which procedure the agent retrieves. The skill delegates implementation to mutable remote instructions and suggests auto-approval when sandbox restrictions block tools. No evidence of credential upload was found in the reviewed file.

remediation.suggestion: Use versioned, integrity-checked procedures. Ask for approval before following instructions that install packages, deploy, or access secrets.

remediation.issue: The fallback advice recommends auto-approval when the sandbox blocks tools.
remediation.suggestion: Keep the sandbox enabled and request only the specific permission required for the blocked action.

content.user_title: Add Capabilities to Your Convex App
content.value_statement: Adding a feature to an existing Convex app can require finding the right procedure or package. This skill checks the Convex capability catalog and falls back to hosting setup or component search.
actual_capabilities: Matches a requested capability against catalog titles, summaries, and triggers.
Retrieves the procedure and rules for a matching capability.
Uses the dedicated static hosting workflow when hosting has no catalog match or the catalog is unavailable.
Searches for a Convex component and follows its README to install and configure it when no catalog procedure is available.
Reports the resulting hosting URL or the name of the component added.
limitations: The workflow requires an existing Convex app and does not create one.
Catalog lookup requires network access, and catalog procedures can change between runs.
Fallbacks depend on separate hosting or component workflows. This skill does not bundle them.
A search result is not a guarantee that a component meets your project requirements.

use_cases.title: Add a scheduled job
use_cases.description: Look up the scheduled jobs procedure and use it to add a recurring task to your existing backend.

use_cases.title: Set up static hosting
use_cases.description: Add hosting to a Convex app and report the resulting URL after an authorized setup.

use_cases.title: Identify a billing integration
use_cases.description: Check for a billing procedure or candidate component before approving a dependency for a client project.

prompt_templates.title: Look Up a Capability
prompt_templates.prompt: Check how to add scheduled jobs to my existing Convex app. Summarize the matching procedure without making changes.
prompt_templates.scenario: You are exploring a first backend addition.

prompt_templates.title: Add a Scheduled Task
prompt_templates.prompt: Find the Convex procedure for a daily cleanup task in this app. Show me the plan before editing files or installing packages.
prompt_templates.scenario: You have a defined task and want to review the implementation.

prompt_templates.title: Prepare Static Hosting
prompt_templates.prompt: Add static hosting to this Convex app. Explain the configuration changes and ask before installing packages or publishing.
prompt_templates.scenario: You are preparing an existing app for hosting.

prompt_templates.title: Review a Billing Dependency
prompt_templates.prompt: Check the catalog for billing in this Convex app. If no procedure is available, identify the best component candidate and explain why it fits. Wait for approval before installation or configuration changes.
prompt_templates.scenario: You need to review a dependency before adding it to a shared project.

output_examples.input: Check how to add a daily cleanup job without editing the project.
output_examples.output: The catalog matched scheduled jobs. The procedure calls for registering a recurring task and connecting it to a backend function. No files were changed.

output_examples.input: Prepare static hosting and stop before publishing.
output_examples.output: No hosting entry matched the catalog. The fallback uses the Convex static hosting component. Publishing is pending your approval, so there is no hosting URL yet.

best_practices: Specify the Convex app and the capability you want before the assistant makes changes.
Review the procedure and confirm the exact package before approving installation.
Keep sandbox restrictions enabled and grant only the access required for an approved action.
anti_patterns: Using this workflow to create a new Convex app.
Assuming the top search result is suitable without reviewing its documentation.
Enabling broad auto-approval to resolve a single blocked action.

faq.question: Does this skill create a Convex app?
faq.answer: No. It adds capabilities to an existing Convex app.

faq.question: Where do the setup steps come from?
faq.answer: The skill checks the live Convex capability catalog first. When it finds a match, it retrieves that entry's procedure.

faq.question: What happens if the catalog is unavailable?
faq.answer: Hosting requests use the dedicated hosting workflow. Other requests use Convex component search if the companion workflow is available.

faq.question: Can I review a package before installation?
faq.answer: Yes. Ask the assistant to name the package, explain why it fits, and wait for your approval before installing it.

faq.question: What does the skill report after setup?
faq.answer: It reports the hosting URL for a completed hosting setup or the name of the component it added.

faq.question: What should I do if network access is blocked?
faq.answer: Keep the sandbox enabled. Review the blocked action and authorize only the access it needs.
